title: PCODKyahotahai /Symptoms, UltrasoundinPCOD/Dr. Shikha Agarwal
description: PCOD is a lifestyle disorder, 5- 10% females are affected from this disease.  Genetic and environmental factor like obesity, unhealthy diet play a imortant role . Symtoms areAmenorrhoea , delayed period 40- 60 days. Abnormal growth hair on face , lip, chin, and abdomen.

asr.full_text: PCOD Recently it has become so common that you can see in young age also 5 to 10 % female patients can be affected by PCOD Means if 100 percent are women then out of that about 10 of 10 women can have PCOD Earlier PCOD was in middle age , in the 30s to 40s But even today in the young age PCOD can be seen today's generation works on computer and laptop for a long time their lifestyle is so that, the girls sit at home play games on the mobile do exercise on their nose. And eat junk food. They eat pizza, burger, chowmein etc junk foods. Which have high amount of Carbohydrate , Fat, Sugar and Salt. It causes the body to gain weight and once it increases the PCOD problem starts. During this time you will take a small amount of water and use the same water for some time During this cycle, you will get rid of all the stress and weight and once it increases, the PCUD will start So the PCUD has started and again you will start having increased weight Hipertension also takes place some are suffering from problem of thyroid In people who are under stress they see increased PUCOD When these girls want to conceive there will be problem in conceiving Every month a male egg is released from the ovary Means ovary is formed with one egg which is egg is born during mide 1 egg is taken out per 24-36 hrs when it reaches in fallopian tube On PCOD when this egg is not released then estrogen helps in release and this increases male hormones But this hormone suppresses estrogen Is estrogen works? Egg release When it happens so we can't release egg Because of that egg's size increases Multiple follicle or multiple cyst start increasing And when eggs aren't released After 15 days of eggs release The ovary contains so many cells and multiple cysts The ovary contains so many cells and multiple cysts When the egg is not released When the egg is released the period starts 15 days after the ovary When the egg is not released the period is also stopped or they come after 3 to 4 months Lets talk about the reason Reason for GENETIC FACTOR & ENVIRONMENTAL FACTOR Science thinks that genetic and environmental factors are involved in it. Research has not led much to it, but a gene is located in this which happens in babies and its manifestation starts at a young age due to which PCOD can be caused. So, it has been shown that that who have PCOD mother and sister, other girls also have greater PUCD As seen, women who have mother and sister with PCOD, they too have PCOD. The biggest symptom for this is not getting time periods. after 3 months after 30 days their cycle also delays that means normal time period is between 28 & 30 days but in patients with PCOD this cycle is between 40 & 60 days which means from 1 and half one to 3 months second symptom is seputation of the face, increasing hair growth hair get on lips andint and lips and belly They come after a period of 3 months and do not want hair on their face. They have problem in sleeping and get disturbed with at night. If there are symptoms like these, then we should check that AltraZone taken. This is a case of Polycystic ovary disease. You can see that the ovary has increased in size. Multiple small follicles can be seen all around the ovary. These are more than 10, their size might be 5-9mm Обрий's volume increases Normal vol of Obriers is 5-7cc But PCOD has more volume on Obriers This is more than that of PCOD In this Obry is ecogenic And around Obary's the cell-cells are arranged like this As seen in the pattern of necklace or the appearance of pearls The follicles around the nose are arranged in this way like we can see neckless pattern or pulse sting appearance i.e. like we can see pearls Along with ultrasound, doctors also advise some blood tests which are done on the second day of the period such as FSH, LH, TSH Blood sugar fasting, PP testosterone If you have liked this information then please like and subscribe BPA , LH , TSH , Blood sugar, Fasting , PP & Testosuron If you like this information then do like and subscribe Thanks for watching Stay healthy Stay blessed
